official_definition: Flash - Sound Speed (Either Attack Step) You can summon this card from your hand by paying the cost from either your Reserve or by paying from your Red/Green Grandwalker Nexus(es) and sending the cores to the Void.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Sound Speed] or [Sound Speed: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Sound Speed]", "give [Sound Speed]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
